coordination.fact: A create-only attempt for model_input_control_binding_v1.py returned that the path already existed because a parallel organ had created the primitive. This organ re-entered that implementation and strengthened the same retained PR1263 lane instead of creating a competing binder or executor.

finding.observation: The parallel HCU_MODEL_INPUT_CONTROL_ADMISSION_STORE/v1 already atomically revalidated exact consumed input bytes and a semantically valid admitted ModelExecutionObservation, and cross-bound generation/executor/invocation/GRID hash/cell/role/input identity. However ModelInputControlBinding.entry_event_sha256, entry_admission_sha256 and route_decision_sha256 remained independent caller parameters. The store did not revalidate those labels against the scheduler-owned GridPlan on first admission.
finding.counterhypothesis: Cross-binding grid_plan_sha256 to the admitted ModelExecutionObservation is sufficient because the GridPlan digest semantically implies its Entry/route parent fields.
finding.reason: The binding contains separate causal-parent fields. Without receiving and validating the exact GridPlan, the admission store has no object from which to compare those independent labels; a first self-consistent binding can therefore name the right GridPlan digest while carrying different Entry/route labels. A later divergent replay fence does not repair the first-admission semantic gap.

mechanism: admit_model_input_control_binding now requires the exact GridPlan object
validate_grid_plan_identity is executed inside the same admission transaction before control rows are installed/persisted
binding.grid_plan_sha256, the validated GridPlan identity and the admitted ModelExecutionObservation grid identity must match
binding generation, entry_event_sha256, entry_admission_sha256 and route_decision_sha256 must match the scheduler-owned GridPlan
the named cell must be unique, ExecutionClass.MODEL and exactly MODEL:<binding.role>
all failures occur before a control binding/invocation row is committed

three_tracks.A_ENTITYOS_EXECUTABLE_CONVERGENCE: ADVANCED: the single retained model-input control admission path now derives its causal parent from the exact scheduler-owned GridPlan rather than accepting three independent Entry/route labels on first admission.
three_tracks.B_HCU_AND_TYPED_ENTRY_FABRIC_CO_DEVELOPM: ADVANCED: Typed Entry event/admission and deterministic route identity are now explicitly cross-bound through GridPlan into HCU model-input control evidence in the same MiniUnifiedDB admission transaction.
three_tracks.C_GLOBAL_JSPACE_GWT_PROTOTYPE_AND_TRAINI: ADVANCED: a byte-valid Vector-Control/Input binding can no longer be admitted under a different Entry/route causal lineage merely by choosing caller labels; downstream model/J-Space promotion still requires explicit admission identity echo and exact execution evidence.

executor_boundary.reason: The fixed executor candidate remains an immutable source/runtime discriminator. New donor semantics are not silently projected into it while no exact-head admitted FREE_ONLY deployment is available.

readme.reason: the artefact/README.md remains a rapidly moving shared whole-file surface while current main and PR1263 are advancing in parallel. The bounded exact-identity delta is append-only in this receipt; a stale full-file replacement would risk erasing newer admitted state.
